subject: drv.motion.backing
item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=0 ms: The road user points northeast and moves southwest with velocity [-0.7071066, -0.7071066] m/s. Its rearward component along the unit heading is approximately 0.999999744 m/s, below the 1 m/s motion tolerance, but the heading's micrometre-truncated normalization makes the body compute a rearward component greater than 1 m/s. — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "Measured as the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along its heading (kin.heading, unit vector) lying below the negative of the motion tolerance, the speed below which a sampled motion counts as none."
reason: The contract measures the component along its heading by naming the atom kin.heading. That atom's contract states that a formula reads the heading as the unit vector times a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶. On the executed facts (heading [1, 1], velocity [-0.7071066, -0.7071066], tolerance 1 m/s), the component as kin.heading delivers it lies just past -1 m/s, so reading the contract through its named atom gives the body's verdict. — "a formula reads it normalised: divided by its larger absolute component, then by its length taken to a micrometre, so the vector read is the unit vector times a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶"
situation: The road user points northeast and moves southwest with velocity [-0.7071066, -0.7071066] m/s. Its rearward component along the unit heading is approximately 0.999999744 m/s, below the 1 m/s motion tolerance, but the heading's micrometre-truncated normalization makes the body compute a rearward component greater than 1 m/s.
contract_words: Measured as the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along its heading (kin.heading, unit vector) lying below the negative of the motion tolerance, the speed below which a sampled motion counts as none.

subject: drv.interaction.overtakes
item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=1000 ms: At the second observation, different but aligned headings and lateral separation make each user wholly behind the other in its own heading projection. Neither was behind the other at the earlier observation, when their headings were opposed; the body nevertheless accepts the recognition observation itself as the SINCE witness. — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "The act is recognized at the observation at which a becomes wholly ahead of b, that is, at which drv.position.behind of b relative to a becomes true, provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation and the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance) at every observation from that one to the recognition."
reason: In the executed facts, the headings are opposed at t=0 ([1,0] vs [-1,0]), so a is not behind b at any observation before t=1000. The body's SINCE accepts a behind b at the recognition observation itself as the witness, but the contract requires that witness at an earlier observation. The unknown clause does not apply either, because the headings were not aligned since the recording began, so the contract's verdict is fails. — "provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation and the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance) at every observation from that one to the recognition"

subject: drv.motion.right_turn_from_onset
item: divergence 1 (fails_wrongly) at t=750 ms: With turn_angle set to zero, a second observed right-turn onset is itself a recognition observation. The body misses it because the heading-change comparison was already true at the intervening non-turning observation. — contract: holds, body: fails; contract: "The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change since that beginning first reaches the negative of the turn angle. The concept holds at the recognition observation only."
reason: In the executed facts turning_right falls at t=500 and rises again at t=750, so 750 is the new observed beginning. The heading change since it is 0, which reaches −0 first at 750, so the contract holds there. The body fails because its rising edge looks at the heading comparison, which was already true at t=500 when measured from the old onset; that is a wrong onset, not a choice of parameter size. — "The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change since that beginning first reaches the negative of the turn angle."
